book: G3_COMBINED = paper books G3_LONG (long sleeve) + G3_SHORT (short sleeve)
status: staged (config/paper.g3_staged.toml, G3_LONG / G3_SHORT start __T_ADD__ placeholder); not live
verdict_codex: paper only, no real capital, no x3 (Codex B5 review, session 01a124e0-8cc4-76b2-9038-1e5868334e7e: 조건부 YES live paper 후보; 실자본·x3 NO)
frozen_hypothesis: normalised score/SVI keep fixed boundaries; funding gate uses previous-90-event robust-z raw boundary median90 + c*1.4826*MAD90 (c in {-0.5,0}); only target vol adapts (trailing sigma_ann quantile or V-ENS mean); 0.5 F42 + 0.5 S180 long ensemble dilutes long profit concentration; maker 4 bps rt

short.vol: mean of min(1,Q/sigma) for W180-P50, W180-P65, W365-P50, W365-P65; any NaN -> flat

params.sigma: std of previous 180 4h log returns, current excluded; sigma_ann=sigma4*sqrt(6*365)

funding_semantics: strict: latest event j with funding_time < T; threshold sample = previous 90 events (event j excluded), min 30 finite
mad0_rule: MAD90 == 0 -> threshold = median90 (scale-degenerate raw boundary collapses to the median; not a defined robust-z). DEV MAD0 decisions 4046/14832, TEST 0
decision_time: UTC 00/04/08/12/16/20; dec4 = 239 + 240k from 2020-01-01 00:00; order time T = closed 4h bar open + 1m (paper records decision_time / exit_decision_time = research bar time + 1m, Codex HIGH fix)

execution.entry: maker limit 2 bps (long floor(close*(1-0.0002)/0.1)*0.1, short ceil(close*(1+0.0002)/0.1)*0.1), TTL 60 1m bars, 0.5 bp trade-through, gap-through rejects
execution.exit: target != held side -> passive 2 bps favourable quote, requote every 60m at new close, 0.5 bp penetration, until filled; new decisions ignored while exit pending; no immediate reversal
execution.sizing: weight frozen at entry decision until exit
execution.cost: maker 4 bps round trip x weight, slippage 0, PESS funding (actual events), 1m MTM

capital: common NAV; each sleeve <= 1x, gross <= 2x (net = wL - wS); P&L is the plain sum of sleeve bps of NAV; no x3 overlay
state_machines: two independent sleeves, each an incremental state machine over closed 1m bars (FLAT -> ENTRY_PENDING -> OPEN -> EXIT_PENDING -> FLAT) = minute-by-minute batch-2 simulate(kind='state'); flat start at the book start, no inherited position

paper_implementation.engine: out/run_new_model_batch5_20261010.py (+ batch4/3/2/1) imported unchanged (sha256 c55285f27c8d17167894d74e8ff68f99c3efb5c71ab7d013060e075288fec428); build_state / core_signal only
paper_implementation.signal_inputs: 4h decision-bar closes since 2020-01-01 (DEV artifacts/btcusdt_2020_2026h1.parquet < 2026-01-01 + R2-54 FINAL snapshot [2026-01-01, 2026-10-08) cached as ~15k floats; live klines_1m >= 2026-10-08) + all funding events (DEV archive < 2026-01-01, live funding table >= 2026-01-01, < data end); identical to the research inputs, so signals are bit-exact; computed only on cycles that contain a 4h decision bar

storage.g3_events: append-only (INSERT OR IGNORE, PK book/event_time/event_type): DECISION, ENTRY_ORDER, ENTRY_FILL, ENTRY_EXPIRED, EXIT_ORDER, EXIT_REQUOTE, EXIT_FILL; payload + code_hash + config_hash + observed_at
storage.g3_state: resume point per sleeve book (state machine + last processed bar), written in the same transaction as its events
storage.trades: closed trades appended once (INSERT OR IGNORE), PESS, candidate = config id, exit_reason TARGET_CHANGE; batch-2 Book net4
storage.daily_pnl: derived from the stored ledger (batch-2 Book 1m MTM net4 incl. open trade + reserved 2 bps exit fee), upsert per UTC day since the start day; never deleted
storage.g3_health: last_success, last_error, last_error_at, last_bar, stale (data end - next bar > 5 min)

paper_implementation.fail_closed: missing minute -> the sleeve commits the contiguous prefix and stops before the gap (g3_health 'gap after ...', stale 1) and resumes when the minute arrives; missing 4h bar or signal -> cycle error, nothing committed; behavior hash mismatch -> no progress, 'behavior_hash_mismatch', stale 1; signal input hash mismatch -> no progress, 'input_hash_mismatch', stale 1
paper_implementation.not_written: positions, OPT rows, x3, Telegram, dashboard
paper_implementation.behavior_hash: sha256(json{code_hash, verified input hashes, book, sleeve params, execution params, book start}); stored in g3_state.state.behavior_hash and in every g3_events.code_hash
paper_implementation.migration: scripts/paper_g3_migrate.py --book G3_LONG|G3_SHORT: --apply (same start only; MIGRATION event, state re-stamped) or --reset (changed start; RESET event with the old state, flat at the new start, start must be after the old last bar) (sha256 054605d357d9d71be27528fc99c24cd788ff77b1ad27fa579d843709ed360143)
paper_implementation.code_hash_line_endings: CRLF normalised to LF before hashing

risks: no x3 / dashboard / Telegram: G3 is visible in the DB only (g3_events, g3_state, g3_health, trades, daily_pnl)
daily_pnl is derived (upsert): a revised funding row can change a past day's MTM; decisions, orders, fills and closed trades are immutable
